[I45] 【他】想他的朋友   correction: 他 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here. Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the action reaches a result, so use <resultative complement>.  Her terms: 吃到result, 写下, 撞到+Obj., 把Obj. V. Resultative complement

  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.   rule card (directional_complements, Grammar): Use V. + directional complement + Place + 来/去: put the place after the directional complement and before 来/去. [I49] 他的妈妈【找到孟子一个老师】   correction: 找到孟子一个老师 → 给孟子找到一个老师   strength: error
  checker's note: 给孟子 marks the person for whom she found a teacher

For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Pattern: <老是 + action> → <一直/常常 + action>: the action is neutral or positive, not something negative to complain about, so do not use 老是.  Her terms: 老是

items.explanation: 他 is already clear from the previous clause, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.
想念 means “to miss” someone. Use 想念 for missing his friends.
他 is already clear in this close continuation, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.
不想离开 means “does not want to leave.” 不要 is usually used for a command or refusal.
Use 给孟子 to show that his mother found a teacher for Mencius.
孟子 should be the subject before 跟老师. Say 孟子跟老师学.
Becoming a philosopher is a completed change in the story, so it takes 了completed.
